environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443 terminated at the instance via nginx. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No application-layer inspection. Instance profile has no special permissions. SQLite database on local EBS volume.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP mode, no content inspection
config.tls_termination: nginx on instance, proxy_pass to localhost:8080
config.database: SQLite on local EBS gp3 volume
